The poster spelling is TCR Chain Paring; the candidate catalogue page is accepted because its heading, named chain targets, oil-emulsion enclosure and sequence of captions match this exact row. STRT above, TCR-LA-MC PCR below, and the right-hand chemical legend are neighboring context, not additional targets or connected branches. This is a schematic architecture, not a claim about every TCR-pairing implementation. Nested amplification and suppression are represented as separate substrate fates in the same selective-PCR stage, not as a linear conversion of fused molecules into the illustrated unfused inhibited form. Sequencing is stated in the catalogue; adapter construction and sequencing operations are not drawn in the assigned row.
